1.title: US scraps limits on emissions from coal and gas power plants
1.summary: The Environment Protection Agency says the move will save the country billions of dollars and reduce energy prices.

2.title: As A.I. Fears Rise, Experts Suggest Focusing on the Humans in Charge
2.summary: Warnings from industry leaders about doomsday scenarios ignore the power that people have to control how artificial intelligence is used, policy experts say. They are urging lawmakers to act now.

3.title: Maduro Ally Is Expected to Plead Guilty in Federal Money Laundering Case
3.summary: Alex Saab, a former high-ranking government official in Venezuela, could potentially cooperate against Mr. Maduro, who is awaiting trial in New York.

4.title: Legendary costume designer Bob Mackie dies aged 87
4.summary: The "Sultan of Sequins" created iconic and dazzling costumes for stars including Cher, Tina Turner and Elton John.

5.title: Syrians Protest as Surge in Fuel Prices Adds to Cost-of-Living Crisis
5.summary: The government’s decision to increase prices as much as 40 percent spurred widespread demonstrations across the country.

6.title: She Bashed the Government on a Private Call. Then She Was Detained for Months
6.summary: Racial and political tensions have flared in Trinidad and Tobago after members of an ethnic minority were accused of an assassination plot based on a private phone call.
